items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1976-02-19
items.q: he owned a club called the Downbeat, where these musicians got together and met. And, uh, he invited me over there one time to discuss a major concert

ctx.x: And, uh, the first concert I brought in, in fact, uh, for them, in fact, the only time when I actually ever produced a bebop concert, which I did not produce under my own name, but which featured Lenny Tristano and Fats Navarro and, uh, Billy Bauer and, uh, certain other musicians whose activity was, uh, significant at that time. Uh, you asked about Miles Davis before. Uh-huh. I met Miles Davis in Philadelphia, too. And I met him, uh, there was a, a fellow by the name of Nat Siegel, who was a small, he owned a…
